acceptanceCriteria.command: legion gh -- pr diff <pr-number> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke  # confirm a single added line in SMOKE.md and no other file changed
acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A pull request against sjawhar/legion-smoke appends exactly one line, 'Stage 3 smoke proof (S391694762-1).', to SMOKE.md and changes nothing else.
acceptanceCriteria.skill: none: repository has no agent skill for a markdown append; the surface is the GitHub PR diff itself, driven by legion gh.
acceptanceCriteria.surface: The GitHub pull request diff (production-like: the real repository branch and PR), and the merged main branch after a human merges.

filesToChange.change: Create the file at the repository root containing exactly one line: 'Stage 3 smoke proof (S391694762-1).' (the file is currently absent; a lowercase smoke.md exists but is a different path on this case-sensitive filesystem and must not be touched).

integrationEvidence: PR against sjawhar/legion-smoke with branch legion/S391694762-1 and body line 'Dispatch: S391694762-1'; CI (ci.yml 'check' job) green at head; PR diff shows the single SMOKE.md addition; after merge, SMOKE.md on main contains the line.

implement: legion-worker: governs the implementer's jj/push/PR workflow, bookmark naming (legion/S391694762-1), PR body 'Dispatch:' line, and the E2E (implementer) proof format required for this one-file change.
review: legion-worker: defines the reviewer's GitHub-fact verification, thread disposition, thermonuclear pair, and single-review-per-round discipline for this PR.
test: legion-worker: defines the tester's duty to verify the implementer's proof and add its own E2E (tester) line by independently driving the PR-diff surface.

risks: Case collision: an existing lowercase smoke.md must not be edited; the target is uppercase SMOKE.md. On this case-sensitive Linux filesystem they are distinct paths.
Scope creep: the diff must touch only SMOKE.md; any second file fails acceptance and must be corrected.
In-scope follow-up: a review may request one additional appended line to SMOKE.md; that second line is in scope and needs no new issue.
summary: Append exactly one line 'Stage 3 smoke proof (S391694762-1).' to SMOKE.md at the repository root of sjawhar/legion-smoke, creating the file with only that line since it does not yet exist, and changing nothing else. Docs-only, one-file change; proven on the pull-request diff and the merged main branch.
tasks: Implement: create SMOKE.md at repo root with the single line 'Stage 3 smoke proof (S391694762-1).'; verify the working-copy diff touches only SMOKE.md; commit, set bookmark legion/S391694762-1, push, and open the PR with body line 'Dispatch: S391694762-1'.

Implement evidence: run 'legion gh -- pr diff' and confirm exactly one added line in SMOKE.md and no other file changed; record as the E2E (implementer) proof with a negative control (e.g. a diff touching a second file is rejected).
Test: re-run the implementer's pr-diff command independently and confirm the single-line SMOKE.md change; record the E2E (tester) proof and verdict.
Review: verify CI green, threads, and both E2E lines on GitHub; run the thermonuclear pair once at the final head; approve the head carrying no .legion/.
Integrate: merger runs threads resolve, verifies no changes above the approved head, publishes READY; after human merge, implementer confirms the line on main.
testStrategy: Docs-only, one-file change: no unit or integration test earns a place. Acceptance is proven by reading the PR diff (single added line in SMOKE.md, nothing else) on the real PR surface, and confirming the line on the merged main branch. Negative control: a diff that touches any file other than SMOKE.md is rejected per the spec's error table.
